title: Directions flow (states)
subtitle: From a chosen place to routes on the map. Loading always ends: a sleeping routing service is waited for at most twice, then Try again. Nothing about a route is stored or logged (P012c1, ADR 0020)

nodes.label: Closed: the place card with Directions. The first time ever, the Intro comes next; afterwards it is skipped
Intro (once ever): your start and destination are sent to SafeRoute, nothing is stored
NeedsOrigin: no permission, searching or no position. Sends nothing; 'Use my location' is the usual permission flow
Loading: one request (POST /v1/routes). Another mode or Try again cancels it and starts a new one
Loading, 'Starting the routing service': shown after 5 s, or on 503 with Retry-After
Wait Retry-After (at most 15 s) and ask again, at most 2 times
Results: 1 to 3 cards (duration, distance, Fastest), credit line; routes on the map, camera fits the selected one
Tap a card: another route is selected; no request, the map stays put
Answer about the places (no Try again): outside covered area, no route, not near a road, too far
Failed with Try again: offline, rate limited, unavailable, or still starting after the waits
Close, back, or another place: routes leave the map and memory
